title: M0 Decisions and spikes
description:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

Entry criteria: This plan on the board; the design note PR open.
Exit criteria: The open decisions in the design note answered (or their recommended defaults accepted); the two spikes closed with findings and a chosen design (access-rule claims PPY-9f3de0 via PPY-867f76 and PPY-f4d892; edge PPY-3b3cc3 via PPY-7cd7a2 and PPY-8891e2); the Prospectus spike PPY-6d9a6d closed (answered 2026-11-08 from Prospectus epic kanbus-b770c2); PPY-9d27c2 (record the reversal) done; inventory PPY-cd5926 and GSI ledger PPY-8f2c4f merged.
Customer-visible: Nothing.
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: None.
Contains: PPY-9f3de0 (PPY-867f76, PPY-f4d892), PPY-3b3cc3 (PPY-7cd7a2, PPY-8891e2), PPY-6d9a6d, PPY-9d27c2, PPY-cd5926, PPY-8f2c4f, PPY-46635e
Not gating: PPY-8eca5b (bring-your-own Google client spike; after M7).
Follows: nothing.

Acceptance (Gherkin; the scenarios live in the named feature files, each also on its task):
Scenario: A token for alpha cannot touch beta's Item (features_backend/tenant-claims-spike.feature, PPY-867f76)
Scenario: An editor cannot move a row to another tenant (same file, PPY-9f3de0)
Scenario: An index list returns full pages for the caller's tenant (same file, PPY-f4d892)
Scenario: Purging alpha's page leaves beta's cached (features_backend/shared-edge-spike.feature, PPY-7cd7a2)
Scenario: A customer domain serves one tenant (same file, PPY-8891e2)
Scenario: The inventory is current (features_backend/tenant-key-inventory.feature, PPY-cd5926)
Scenario: Two new indexes on one table fail the build (features_backend/gsi-ledger.feature, PPY-8f2c4f)
Scenario: An existing site synthesises exactly as before (features_backend/tenancy-mode.feature, PPY-46635e)
Scenario: The docs state both tiers (PPY-9d27c2)

Acceptance checks (evidence recorded on this issue):
1. Each spike issue has a yes/no answer per sub-question with evidence and names the design chosen; if the claim rules fail, the fallback (custom resolvers reading claims) is written into the design note the same day and the isolation chain re-estimated.
2. Sandbox stacks from the spikes are destroyed (aws cloudformation list-stacks shows none left).
3. npx tsx scripts/generate-tenant-key-inventory.ts --check and the GSI ledger check pass in CI on develop.
4. The design note's open-decisions list shows each item answered or "default accepted".
